title: Units Ledger Standard: Unused Units on an Ended Prior Authorization Approval
content:
**Units Ledger Standard — Prior Authorization, units returned on expiry**

1. **Definition.** The units an expiry release returns are the units granted on the ended approval, less the units posted as used on it, less any units already released from it, counted in whole units and never below zero.

2. **Records read.** All three quantities are read from the units ledger of that one Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization approval:
   - *units granted* — every grant entry on the approval (the initial approval, a transition-of-care grant and any extension grants), added together;
   - *units posted as used* — every use entry posted by a paid claim on the approval, added together;
   - *units already released* — every release entry already booked on the approval, added together.

3. **Order of the figure.** The units posted as used and the units already released are each taken away from the units granted; where that leaves less than nothing, the figure is zero. The figure is a whole number of units in the class's own unit basis (studies, visits, items or rental months, program days or inpatient days).

### Condition, judgement, result

| Input on the approval | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Granted exceeds used plus released | The difference is positive | That difference, in whole units, is returned |
| Granted equals used plus released | Nothing is left unused | Zero units |
| Used plus released exceeds granted | The difference would be negative | Zero units, never a negative figure |

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, for illustration only)

- *Example A.* An ended approval shows 12 units granted, 7 units posted as used and no release entry. The units returned are twelve less seven less nothing, that is 5 units.
- *Example B.* An ended approval shows 20 units granted (an initial grant of 12 and an extension grant of 8), 9 units posted as used and 3 units already released. The units returned are twenty less nine less three, that is 8 units.
- *Example C.* An ended approval shows 4 units granted and 4 units posted as used. Nothing is left; the units returned are 0.
